data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 were GBP 1,146.5m. During 2022 the Syndicate recorded a modest release from prior year reserves of GBP 13.6m driven by favourable claims development, partially offsetting significant adverse movements including catastrophe losses (notably Russia-Ukraine and Hurricane Ian), deterioration of COVID-19 estimates and additional reserve loadings for high inflation. The net effect was a strengthening from catastrophe, pandemic and inflation pressures, with some prior-year releases reducing the overall impact.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure used is the narrative-stated 'releases from prior year reserves of GBP 13.6m' (explicit). The technical reserves reconciliation 'movement in provision' was not used because it includes current-year movements. A gross claims development triangle is present in the report but its printed layout in the extract made reliable cell-level extraction difficult; triangle is noted but not fully parsed for a cross-check. Some LOB-level reserve movements are not disclosed; LOB movement amounts are therefore null and assigned low confidence.
